title: Red Hat Security Advisory: gdb security update
description: A security vulnerability (CVE-2026-13732) has been identified in the GNU Debugger (GDB) affecting Red Hat Enterprise Linux 9.4 variants. The flaw is an out-of-bounds write in the STABS parser function read_member_functions() triggered by crafted ELF files. This vulnerability has been rated as important by Red Hat Product Security and affects multiple architectures including x86_64, ppc64le, aarch64, and s390x. A security update is available to address this issue.
